title: Decoupled Clickable & Focus Isolation, Category Scroll Lock, Safe Watchlist & Podcast Channel Transitions
releaseNotes:
• Elimination of Ghost Clicks (Decoupled Clickable): Replaced Compose combinedClickable on TvFocusableCard with pure focusable + onPreviewKeyEvent + pointerInput, eliminating Compose's internal DPAD_CENTER key listener that was erroneously triggering clicks on leaked focus nodes (e.g. AppTab.LIVE)
• Strict 1200ms Global Key Suppression: Any long-press globally swallows all KeyDown and KeyUp events for 1200ms across all focusable cards in the application, guaranteeing key release cannot trigger unintended actions
• Category Up-Scroll Containment: Added focusProperties { up = FocusRequester.Cancel } directly to the category LazyColumn across Live TV, Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts, locking upward scroll strictly within the category list and completely preventing focus escape to the preview screen
• Safe Watchlist & Channel Transitions: Focus safely transitions to adjacent items before updating list state, preventing focus from dropping to the sidebar when removing items or opening podcast channels
